snippet.title: Mega Man Maker Version 1.9 release trailer!
snippet.description:
Join the official Discord: https://discord.com/invite/a3BAjBn

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/MegaManMaker

Trailer by Objectionable: @objectionable6693 

Intro Animation by Luigi1000: @Luigi1000 

Version 1.9 is one of our most ambitious updates yet! It adds new content from Mega Man 7-11 as well as various other changes you will soon see. Enjoy the update! 

Mega Man Maker is a fan-made game inspired by the Mega Man series. We are not affiliated with Capcom in any way.
